name: A+ Deco Mod
description: An AI that decorates your levels: type a description, pick an object count, done.

default-count.name: Default Object Count
default-count.description: How many objects the A+ window starts with.

max-count.name: Max Object Count
max-count.description: Safety limit for one generation. Very high numbers can lag the editor.

color-triggers.name: Theme Colors On By Default
color-triggers.description: Add 5 color triggers at the start of the level so the deco gets the theme's colors.

color-channel-start.name: First Color Channel
color-channel-start.description: A+ uses 5 color channels starting here (default 50 = channels 50 to 54). Change it if your level already uses them.

deco-group.name: Deco Group ID
deco-group.description: Put every generated object into this group so you can move, hide or toggle all of it at once. 0 = no group.

use-extra-objects.name: Discover Extra Objects
use-extra-objects.description: Also use other decoration objects the mod finds in your game (glows, lights, more clouds...). Turn off for only the built-in set.

keep-open.name: Keep Window Open
keep-open.description: Keep the A+ window open after generating (otherwise it closes so you can see the result).

use-claude.name: Use Claude AI By Default
use-claude.description: Start with the 'Claude AI (online)' toggle on. Needs an API key below.

claude-api-key.name: Claude API Key
claude-api-key.description: Your Anthropic API key (from console.anthropic.com). Only used when the Claude toggle is on. Stored locally in your Geode save folder.

claude-model.name: Claude Model
claude-model.description: Which Claude model designs the deco plan.
